title: 第21章 先天葫芦护山神藤第22章 收取青莲鸿钧震惊
slug: 洪荒开局吞噬十一祖巫
content_zh:
亿万里之外，一处无名山谷中，陆续响起了压抑的痛哼与剧烈的咳嗽声，帝江的这次出手居然是又幸运的将他们又聚到了一起。
太清嘴角溢血，道袍破损，头顶的天地玄黄气都黯淡了几分，盘坐于地，面色前所未有的凝重，默默运功疗伤。
玉清也是狼狈，发髻散乱，脸色铁青，一边咳血一边低吼：“奇耻大辱！
真乃奇耻大辱！”
他纵横洪荒至今，何曾受过如此对待？
上清擦去嘴角血迹，眼中却闪过一丝惊悸与后怕，那五行神光的威力，让他真正感受到了死亡的威胁，此刻回想起来依旧心有余悸，故而沉默不语。
帝俊与太一互相搀扶着，太阳真火明灭不定，显然也受了不轻的内伤，脸色阴沉得能滴出水来。
女娲伏羲兄妹亦是气息萎靡，伏羲琴弦都断了两根，需要慢慢温养。
红云最惨，全靠镇元子以地书之力护住，才没当场昏死过去。
镇元子自己也是气血翻腾，苦笑着摇头。
九位在洪荒赫赫有名的大能，此刻却是个个带伤，灰头土脸，模样凄惨。
他们耗费了不少元气，才勉强稳住伤势，聚到了一处相对安全的地方。
耻辱、愤怒、不甘，还有一丝难以言喻的恐惧，萦绕在每个人心头。
“此人，究竟是谁？”
帝俊打破了沉默，声音有些沙哑！
太一咬牙道：“不论是谁，他竟未去紫霄宫听道，却难知晓其身份！”
这意味着对方要么是狂妄到无视圣人大道，要么就是自信自身之道不弱于圣人！
无论是哪种，都让他们感到心惊。
“连面都未见，就被打成这般模样，传出去，我等颜面何存？”
玉清恨恨道！

太清缓缓吐出一口浊气，沉声道：“此事不能就此作罢。
至少，我等需知晓其根脚来历。”
女娲点头，美眸闪动：“不错。
如此强横，又占据不周山，绝非无名之辈。
我等不知，或许有人知晓。”
伏羲接口道：“紫霄宫中，或许能寻得答案。”
众人目光一亮。
对啊！
鸿钧道祖乃洪荒圣人，必然知晓那神秘的不周山之主是谁！
“下次紫霄宫开讲，我等定要向圣人问个明白！”
上清握紧了拳头。
“至少要弄清楚，打吾等的是谁！”
红云有气无力地补充了一句，这话说出了所有人的心声。
被人狠狠揍了一顿，却连揍人者姓甚名谁，是何来历都搞不清楚，这憋屈感，简直比身上的伤还让人难受！
这笔账，他们算是记下了。
content_en:
Billions of miles away, in an unknown valley, suppressed groans of pain and violent coughs could be heard one after another. Di Jiang's move was lucky enough to bring them together again.
Taiqing's mouth was bleeding, his Taoist robe was torn, and the black and yellow aura above his head had dimmed a bit. He sat cross-legged on the ground, his face more solemn than ever before, silently doing exercises to heal his injuries.
Yuqing was also in a sorry state, with her hair in a messy bun and her face ashen. She coughed up blood and shouted in a low voice: "What a shame and humiliation!
What a shame! "
Throughout his life, how had he ever been treated like this?
Shangqing wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, but a trace of panic and fear flashed in his eyes. The power of the five elements of divine light made him truly feel the threat of death. Thinking back on it at this moment, he was still frightened, so he remained silent.
Di Jun and Tai Yi supported each other. The true fire of the sun was flickering. It was obvious that they had suffered serious internal injuries, and their faces were so gloomy that they could drip water.
Nuwa and Fuxi's brother and sister are also feeling weak. Two of Fuxi's strings have been broken and need to be warmed up slowly.
Hongyun was the worst. It was only thanks to Zhen Yuanzi's power to protect him that he didn't faint on the spot.
Zhen Yuanzi himself was furious and shook his head with a wry smile.
The nine powerful men who were famous in the ancient times were all injured, disgraced and miserable at the moment.
They spent a lot of energy to barely stabilize their injuries and gathered in a relatively safe place.
Shame, anger, unwillingness, and a hint of unspeakable fear linger in everyone's mind.
"Who is this person?"
Di Jun broke the silence, his voice was a little hoarse!
Taiyi gritted his teeth and said: "No matter who it is, he didn't go to Zixiao Palace to listen to the sermon, but it's hard to know his identity!"
This means that the other party is either so arrogant that he ignores the saint's way, or he is confident that his own way is not weaker than that of the saint!
No matter which one it was, it frightened them.
"We haven't even seen each other, but we were beaten like this. If word spreads, how can we lose our face?"
Yuqing said bitterly!
Taiqing slowly exhaled a breath and said in a deep voice: "This matter cannot be left alone.
At least, we need to know its origins. "
Nuwa nodded, her beautiful eyes flashing: "Not bad.
He is so tyrannical and occupies Buzhou Mountain. He is definitely not an unknown person.
I don't know, maybe someone knows. "
Fuxi said: "We may be able to find the answer in Zixiao Palace."
Everyone's eyes lit up.
yes!
Taoist ancestor Hongjun is a saint from ancient times, so he must know who the mysterious Lord of Mount Buzhou is!
"Next time the Zixiao Palace lectures, I will definitely ask the saint for clarification!"
Shangqing clenched his fists.
"At least we need to find out who hit us!"
Hongyun added weakly, which spoke to everyone's feelings.
I was beaten severely, but I couldn't even figure out the name of the person who beat me, or where he came from. This feeling of embarrassment was even more uncomfortable than the injuries on my body!
They have taken note of this account.
